_readme: R335 A-Conform — Heron (frozen spec) → OUR landing page mapping. Two modes: (a) 'explicit' — heron role path (exact or suffix match) → our CSS selector, resolved inside the section container; (b) heuristic fallback — match by structure: same tag + same text-class (tc) + same ordinal position within that (tag,tc) group in document order. Phase 2 agents add data-spec hooks and extend 'explicit'. 'ourSection' holds the REAL container selectors of our React SPA (verified against frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx r335). [P2-0 split: one file per our-section key. This file: home-map-wrap — the pinned 51% walkthrough, our section#chapters.chapters (sections/Chapters.tsx, scene in journey/JourneyScene). T-09 r338 first pass: explicit bindings for the primary tree (kills the ~54 junk heuristic pairs — the h=7560-wrapper vs 96px-node gluing measured at 45.8% baseline), noCounterpart reasons for heron authored-SVG internal leaves + retired raster stills, plumbing geometry-skips for svg roots.]
